oracle_review.existing_tests: test_accept_reports.py tests report consistency with synthetic passing rows and mutation matrices; main test doubles native execution but retains real gate aggregation. Two tests run small real subprocess report writers. These do not validate checker receipt parsing/semantics.
oracle_review.compatibility: All six original saved gate reports plus two lifecycle generated reports pass current actual aggregator callbacks; historical-report-only evidence is separate in historical-compatibility.json.
oracle_review.timeout: acceptance logs explicitly distinguish watchdog failure from completion. subprocess.run timeout does not establish whole child-tree cleanup. No cleanup claim inferred.

runtime_source_review.roots: NativeHost fields place context/modules/services/foreground before OwnedIsolate and thread guard last. Drop removes service/module slots, drops transport before resolver, clears module roots while isolate remains live. ForegroundRegistration closes early-construction entries; disarm transfers ownership to NativeHost.
runtime_source_review.foreground: Weak registry and queue closed flag discard queued/late tasks; custom platform post wraps waker panic in catch_unwind. Existing tests cover ownership transfer, closed queue, native cached-Wasm foreground posting, and repeated disposal. Arbitrary cross-thread isolate-address reuse is not established by these tests.
runtime_source_review.callbacks: Inspected bootstrap, fixed bridge, module resolver/import callbacks and diagnostics handlers; panic containment is explicit. No reproduced native callback defect.
runtime_source_review.transport: Captured mode/client/Rc budget/config precede authored conversion; pending fetch owns DTOs and future; cancel drops transport before JS promise rejection. Existing loopback tests observe zero starts for eager abort and socket close while host remains live; source-only here.
runtime_source_review.module_authority: Native Worker loader delegates resolve/load to shared BundleModuleLoader; canonical target/same-parent checks and canonical read preserve alias scope and diagnostic attribution.
runtime_source_review.thread_initialization: OnceLock applies to standalone direct-V8 initializer and HostThreadGuard tracks direct hosts per thread. It does not unify deno_core and direct-host initialization/thread ownership; documented phase-two boundary remains.
runtime_source_review.send_sync: No unsafe Send/Sync implementation introduced or observed; Rc/RefCell and owned request/response values preserve thread ownership.
runtime_source_review.verdict: No new runtime defect reproduced. Source inspection is not native lifetime, cleanup, scheduling or browser verification.
